info.name: CYCLES_MATERIAL_CYCLES_XML
comment: Cycles vendor extension: 'cyclesXml' material subtype taking a whole
Cycles shader graph as text. 'source' holds one <shader> element in the
dialect of cyclesphi's XML reader: node elements named after the Cycles
node type with a 'name' attribute and <socket name value/> children,
followed by <connect from_node from_socket to_node to_socket/> elements;
the output node is addressed as 'output'. <socket> children of the
<shader> element set the shader settings. Colors and vectors are 4
floats, transforms 12 floats, arrays are written inline.
Images are passed as ANARI_SAMPLER parameters of any name holding an
'image2D' sampler: an image_texture or environment_texture node whose
'filename' equals the name of such a parameter samples the array of that
sampler (sRGB element types are decoded, all others are linear); filter
and wrap modes of the sampler are ignored, the node has its own.
Geometry attributes are read with attribute nodes named
'vertex.attribute0'..'vertex.attribute7' (4 to 7 are the channels of
CYCLES_GEOMETRY_ATTRIBUTES) and 'vertex.color'. Tangent
space normal maps use the tangent of the geometry ('vertex.tangent').
The graph is parsed again only when 'source' or an image it uses
changed. A text that cannot be used reports an error and renders a gray
diffuse fallback.

objects.name: cyclesXml
objects.description: material driven by a Cycles shader graph given as XML text
